schema_version: 1
owner: ms-go-teacher-agent
tables:
  personal_teacher:
    identity: id
    natural_key: student_id
    concurrency: optimistic version
  personal_teacher_soul:
    identity: personal_teacher_id
    natural_key: student_id
    lifecycle: one independently versioned row per PersonalTeacher/student pair; existing teachers are backfilled
    privacy: bounded persona and relationship settings only; no student learning state or conversation memory
  teacher_decision:
    identity: id
    lifecycle: immutable audit record
    action_link: nullable only for legacy or non-action contexts; new action-context rows require learning_action_id
    pedagogy_audit: method code, method version, and method-neutral stage
  teacher_outbox:
    identity: event_id
    delivery: lease, retry, JetStream acknowledgement
  teacher_learning_action_assistance:
    identity: id
    natural_key: [student_id, learning_action_id]
    lifecycle: immutable teacher-owned assistance audit
  teacher_integration_inbox:
    identity: event_id
    natural_key: [student_id, learning_action_id]
    lifecycle: immutable processed learning_action.closed marker
  teacher_dialog_job:
    identity: event_id from dialog.teacher.requested; teacher_job_id is the local durable identity and dialog_causation_id is preserved separately from derived Teacher-job causation
    natural_key: [dialog_id, source_message_id]
    lifecycle: queued -> processing -> delivery_pending -> delivered|completed, or blocked
    ordering: v1 legacy claims remain unchanged; v2 uses dense teacher_turn_sequence and teacher_dialog_turn_cursor
    reconciliation: unknown|partial|committed_unreconciled never advances the cursor; failed_no_effect requires stored proof and recoverable outcome rows
    privacy: request identities and bounded operational metadata only; generated response retained only until idempotent Dialog append, then cleared
  teacher_dialog_turn_cursor:
    identity: dialog_id
    lifecycle: dense per-dialog next_teacher_turn_sequence with atomic terminal advancement
    concurrency: row lock plus job claim-token fencing
  teacher_dialog_turn_proof:
    identity: no_effect_proof_id
    lifecycle: durable Student-effect absence/receipt reconciliation reference
    privacy: IDs and proof kind only; no Student payload
  teacher_dialog_turn_outcome:
    identity: recoverable_outcome_id
    natural_key: source_event_id
    lifecycle: delivered or failed_no_effect terminal record
    privacy: durable recovery/provenance IDs, turn_correlation_id, and bounded failure code only; TeacherDecision.correlation_id retains its existing learning-action/domain meaning
  teacher_intervention_inbox:
    identity: source learning.activity.interesting event_id
    natural_key: [student_id, analytics_session_id]
    lifecycle: immutable intervene or stay_silent decision plus optional idempotent general-Dialog delivery identity
    privacy: bounded signal type and proactive offer only; no raw analytics, errors, code, mastery, or dialog history
  teacher_telegram_link_code:
    identity: SHA-256 digest of a high-entropy one-time code; plaintext is never persisted
    lifecycle: issued -> consumed or expired; a same-account webhook replay is idempotent
  teacher_telegram_binding:
    identity: student_id
    uniqueness: telegram_user_id and private chat_id each bind to at most one student
    ownership: points to the exact PersonalTeacher/student pair and their general Dialog
  teacher_telegram_delivery:
    identity: source Dialog message_id
    lifecycle: pending -> processing -> sent or blocked with finite claim leases and bounded retry
    privacy: chat identifier and pending response body only; no Telegram profile or duplicate dialog history
  teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox:
    identity: course.plan.completed or course.plan.failed event_id
    lifecycle: accepted -> delivered when a Dialog audit reference exists
    privacy: bounded Teacher audit and result metadata plus localized business notification; no curriculum, mastery, prompt, provider error, or chain-of-thought
  teacher_onboarding_action_receipt:
    identity: UUID client idempotency key
    natural_key: one active claimed or applied action per student/general Dialog
    migration_016_lifecycle: claimed -> applied -> completed; rejected is terminal
    migration_018_execution_modes: legacy|canonical
    migration_018_canonical_lifecycle: claimed -> materialized
    migration_018_commands: canonical_message_command_id is required from canonical claim; canonical_student_message_id is required only after materialization
    migration_018_uniqueness: "[dialog_id, source_message_id, source_message_version, block_id, action_id] for canonical receipts"
    migration_018_rollback: fails closed after any canonical mode, canonical command/message identity, or materialized status is used
    recovery: stable distinct Student and Dialog command UUIDs repair partial downstream success after lease expiry
    privacy: binding/source/block/action identities, hashes, versions, statuses, downstream IDs and timestamps only; no profile answers, labels, option values, or message body
  teacher_onboarding_interaction:
    identity: interaction_id
    lifecycle: active -> reserved -> completed, active -> superseded, or active -> closed
    migration_020_terminal_close: closed_reason is planning_ready|active_path_exists and closed_at is required; no job, receipt, successor, fake UI, or body/digest marker
    migration_020_rollback: drain required; fail closed when closed state/reason/time or canonical claimed|applied|materialized prompt-effect evidence exists
    migration_023_session_schema: nullable only for terminal pre-cutover history; every new row requires immutable version 1|2|3; S11 admission writes 3 and continuations preserve the source version
    migration_023_drain: quiesced deployment rejects every nonterminal interaction, turn, coordinator job, and claimed|applied receipt independently before installing the trigger
    action_terminal_race: exact new canonical claim and terminal close share one per-Dialog transaction fence; reserved or claimed action wins without being stolen
    uniqueness: one active|reserved interaction per Dialog; prompt identity and version are immutable
    privacy: prompt/UI digest, slot code, expected versions, reservation identities and timestamps only
  teacher_onboarding_turn:
    identity: teacher_job_id
    natural_key: source_event_id
    lifecycle: received -> interaction_reserved -> ai_staged|student_staged -> response_staged -> delivery_pending -> delivered, with proof-backed failed_no_effect or blocked_unknown
    causality: at most one causal or fallback AI execution; distinct stable Student and Dialog response commands
    semantic_decision_privacy: selected bounded command_or_confirmation projection only; no provider envelope, prompt variables, model body, or unselected candidates
    user_visible_semantic_reply: existing private teacher_dialog_job response field only until normal Dialog append; never copied into semantic_decision
    migration: 019; default dark
  teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff:
    identity: handoff_intent_id
    natural_key: [student_id, state_ref_kind, state_ref_version]
    lifecycle: queued -> dispatching -> accepted -> message_pending -> delivered; active_path and blocked are terminal alternatives
    command: stable command_id, command_teacher_job_id, request_hash, and notification_command_id; retries reuse exact identities
    acceptance: planner_handoff_id plus readiness_observed_at plus accepted_at are historical write-once admission evidence; notification_message_id plus delivered_at are write-once delivery evidence; execution_status remains NOT_STARTED and content_status remains NOT_CREATED
    source_transfer: optional exact teacher job and interaction references move one accepted S5 turn into handoff_pending before its lease is released
    recovery: expired dispatch/message leases are reclaimed; Planner and Dialog ambiguous acknowledgements replay by stable idempotency keys
    privacy: no Student profile, prompt/model/message body, opaque graph payload, course ID, path ID, or lesson ID
    migration: 021; default dark; down takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks and is allowed only for a never-used empty install; operational rollback disables admission and drains while retaining all ledger evidence
  teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox:
    identity: event_id
    natural_key: execution_id; exact planner_handoff_id correlation is required
    lifecycle: accepted -> delivered; delivery replay reuses event_id as the Dialog idempotency key
    statuses: PATH_READY requires course_id, learning_path_id, and first_lesson_id; ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS and STATE_CHANGED forbid all three
    privacy: exact bounded Student/Dialog/Teacher identities, status-specific path IDs, localized body, and delivery timestamps only; no profile, graph, provider, raw error, or browser/UI data
    migration: 022; default dark; down refuses to remove retained outcome evidence
  teacher_onboarding_terminal_session:
    identity: deterministic terminal_session_id; one row per student
    scope: direct S11 ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS only; exact teacher/dialog/state_ref, schema version 3, stable Dialog command, and pending|delivered acknowledgement
    recovery: pending is persisted before idempotent Dialog append; an exact concurrent delivery acknowledgement replays
    privacy: no body, answers, goal, graph, course, path, lesson, model, or provider data
    protection: immutable causal identity; only message_pending to delivered is allowed; delete and truncate are rejected; migration 023 down refuses retained rows or stamped interactions
atomic_boundaries:
  personal_teacher_creation: PersonalTeacher plus its per-student TeacherSoul
  decision: teacher_decision plus teacher.decision.recorded outbox
  assistance_finalization: learning_action.closed inbox plus optional assistance plus teacher.assistance.observed outbox
  dialog_generation: teacher decision plus teacher.decision.recorded outbox plus pending response body and decision link
  intervention: interesting-activity inbox plus teacher decision plus teacher.decision.recorded outbox
  telegram_link: consume one link code and replace the same student's binding atomically
  course_plan_notification: accept one immutable Teacher-originated terminal outcome before idempotent Dialog delivery
  onboarding_action: durable claim and version fence locally; canonical Dialog materialization and Student application are separately idempotent downstream commands
  onboarding_turn: interaction reservation, turn ledger, and staged response are locally fenced; Student, AI Prompt, and Dialog retain their own authoritative/idempotent boundaries
  onboarding_product_response: exact accepted Student receipt recovery plus Planner read precede one atomic student_staged-to-delivery_pending response stage; terminal/no-effect delivery disposition derives from durable effect and UI fields
  onboarding_handoff_enqueue: exact READY state and goal are inserted once; coordinator origin atomically changes reserved interaction to handoff_pending and releases its job without advancing the dense cursor
  onboarding_handoff_delivery: after idempotent Dialog append, ledger delivery, source interaction/turn/job completion, outcome proof, and dense cursor advancement commit together
  onboarding_path_outcome: exact S8 handoff correlation and outcome inbox commit precede one localized idempotent Dialog append; Teacher does not expose Planner IDs to the browser
  onboarding_path_outcome_projection: delivered row is joined to the exact handoff Student, PersonalTeacher, Dialog, Teacher job, and current state-ref; the browser receives only outcome kind/status and Dialog message ID
forbidden_data:
  - student mastery and learning path
  - learning sessions and attempts
  - dialog messages
  - raw analytics events
  - course content and knowledge graph
  - prompt variables, rendered prompts, raw provider responses, and chain-of-thought
  - raw compiler/test output and error fingerprints
  - Telegram access tokens, webhook secrets, and plaintext link codes
